en: Dependent on a wholesome state accompanied by sustained thought (*savicāra*), a state that is neither accompanied by sustained thought nor wholesome arises by way of root condition (*hetupaccaya*) … [Three for root; ... pe ... three for non-disappearance].

Dependent on an unwholesome state accompanied by sustained thought, a state that is neither accompanied by sustained thought nor unwholesome arises by way of root condition … [Three for root; ... pe ... three for non-disappearance]. (The indeterminate root has exactly three conditions.)
